short.zh: 2026 年 10 月 31 日于上海 The Point 举办的演出预演工作坊。由钱誉文主讲，MANA 提供宣传支持；通过灰盒、空间编排与预演，把演出想法改进为 V2。
short.en: Stage previsualization workshop delivered on Oct 31, 2026 at The Point, Shanghai. Led by Ewan Qian with MANA promotional support; grayboxing, spatial composition and review informed a revised V2.

premise.zh: 不是单纯建模，而是让人物、屏幕、光和时间在数字空间中先运行一次，再从观看中发现问题。
premise.en: Beyond stage modeling: rehearse the relationships among performer, screens, light and time in a digital space, then revise after viewing.

editions.context: Lead Ewan Qian; MANA promotional support; The Point Shanghai venue support
